messages.content: What is the current price of platinum in USD, and why is its supply risky?
Let me fetch the live price and look up the supply context.
The current spot price of platinum is 1012.50 USD per troy ounce.

[Passage 1] Platinum supply is uniquely concentrated in South Africa (~70% of global mine output) and Russia (~12%), making it acutely sensitive to labour unrest, power shortages, and geopolitical shocks.

Platinum is currently trading at $1,012.50 USD per troy ounce. Its supply is considered risky because it is highly concentrated — roughly 70% comes from South Africa and about 12% from Russia. This makes it vulnerable to labour strikes, power shortages, and geopolitical disruptions in those regions.
